decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s), other than those shown on the approved plans shall be installed in the side elevation(s) of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.
The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.
description: Single storey front extension incorporating porch, First floor side extension, Conversion of garage to habitable room, Replace garage door with window in front elevation, Single storey side to rear extension, First floor rear extension, Alterations to roof to form side and rear dormers, Roof lights to front and side roof slopes, Installation of windows in side elevation, External alterations (Demolition of, rear extension, first floor rear bay window and outbuilding at rear), Raised patio (revised description).
